crossRefs.note: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

for our God is a consuming fire.

translations.web: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
translations.bsb: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
translations.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
translations.asv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
